_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the reader judge returned them, round 1; each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Right register; 2, 5 and 9 give one readable subject; 1, 4, 6 and 8 fall back on defaults or primitives; 3's lit third and the rest are both mid grey at 432 px; 2's sign reads as a button.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One floodlit night world, casts run right, no strobe; camera move and ember band both work; the reliefs are a flatter idiom and the band drifts to tan on 9.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; no AI; c8 kept apart from c24. Frame 3's 'the rest' on floor plates can read as the rest also on the floor; frame 1's 'now do much' firms c7's 'can perform much'.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, when and where; no public body or deadline; the staffing question arrives only as the company's word, and the caption's question is the best stake.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 1 to 3 pay; 1, 4 and 5 all say an arm handles the pipe; 7 is an aside; the turn at 6 is soft; the close lands on the company's staffing line.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: The caption opener sounds like the rig; disclaimer lines on six frames and 'Reuters reported' on five.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 68 had pipe racks, a lateral cutaway and a worker by a gate; no. 69 drew ten of twenty for half; the floodlit world repeats no. 67.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Gripper reads as stacked white boxes; no jaws visible; the pipe above is a blurred column.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Turn the camera about 30 degrees so the die-padded jaws wrap the tool joint in profile, run the pipe sharp out of the top, add the cable loom.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Nine plates read as a flat pattern, both columns mid grey at thumb, and 'the rest' sits on floor plates.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Make the lit third the only bright object and say the rest happen elsewhere.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stock control room with invented charts and an empty chair.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An over-the-shoulder contractor and one camera view of the floor on the screens.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mannequin worker cut by the footer; shed, gate, stand and arm split the focus.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the shed, stand the worker full height at the base of the stand, crop the arm out.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The rack in plan reads as blinds; joints run off the bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Fit all 20 joints above the footer and show their round ends.
